legend: The Murder Castle of H. H. Holmes (Chicago, USA)
lines: Chicago, 1893. The whole world came to see the fair.
And a charming doctor was waiting with rooms to rent.
His name was H. H. Holmes.
He built a huge hotel with a hundred windows.
Hallways led nowhere. Doors opened onto solid brick.
A sign said rooms to let. Many guests checked in.
Hidden chutes dropped into a cellar no guest was ever meant to see.
Detectives finally caught him in 1894. He confessed to twenty-seven murders. Only nine could be proven.
A mysterious fire gutted the building before anyone could search it properly.
Would you have booked a room?
title: The Hotel Built To Make Guests Disappear 😨 #shorts
description:
In 1893 a Chicago doctor built a hotel with hidden chutes and doors to nowhere. Dozens of guests were never seen again. This is the legend of H. H. Holmes and his Murder Castle.
